name: Leonard
source: Descendant of the famed Spirit Master of Ritaania who successfully sealed the portal to the demon realm five hundred years before the start of this tale. He retains the knowledge and the tools to summon the spirits his ancestor commanded but is otherwise an ordinary youth who works as an assistant to Ritaania's blacksmith.
